q: In 2 John, how does the writer call himself?
why: He wrote to the chosen lady.
quote: The elder, To the chosen lady and her children

q: In 2 John, what old command does the elder urge?
In 2 John, why was the elder overjoyed?
quote: I was overjoyed to find some of your children walking in the truth

q: In 2 John, how does the elder define love?
quote: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments.

q: In 2 John, why did the elder not write more with paper and ink?
a: He hoped to visit face to face
why: So their joy would be complete.
quote: Instead, I hope to come and speak with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.
